name: Spawn of Opportunity (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability drain or energy drain, lifesense, create spawn, Cha 13

Benefit(s): You can automatically detect a living creature suffering from the helpless condition within long range (400 ft. + 40 ft. per Hit Die). Once per encounter you can perform a coup de grace as an attack of opportunity against a helpless foe that is within your threatened area. If the foe dies from the attack it will become a spawn as part of your create spawn ability regardless if it is from the draining or from the coup de grace.
